text: player
Ugh... I'm so dizzy...
Sure enough, the spinning teacup ride is too stimulating for my senses. After just two or three rounds, my brain starts squealing that it's shaking all over!
Passerby A
Did you hear? The medical station in the zone ahead of us claims that it can cure any disease.
Passerby B
Apparently, they have a special medicine that takes effect in just three to five minutes.
Really? I hope there aren't any hidden risks.

What a wonderful coincidence! It's like someone is handing me a pillow when I'm getting sleepy or a panacea is dropping from the sky when I'm feeling dizzy. I open the amusement park's map navigation and see that I'm about 500 meters from the medical station mentioned by the passers-by.
Go to the medical station that claims it can cure any disease and see what it can do for you!
Pass and rest somewhere nearby
The moment I step inside the medical station, I see a red-haired woman worrying about the patient behind the curtain. Based on what I know about her, this doesn't happen very often.
I never thought there would be a disease you can't cure, Leia.
Leia
{var:player_nickname}? It's you.

Sigh, I seem to have encountered a tricky disease this time. A patient asked me for some energy-boosting medicine in the morning, but it didn't seem to have any effect on her. She's now sleeping on the bed, and I can't seem to wake her up.
...I think your patient is the special one. It's not your problem.
Oh yes, what brings you here today? Are you feeling unwell?
Many of the people who come here give me the same reason. It's okay to have a good time, but don't forget to take care of your health.
Here, take this pill. It should make you feel better.

The short version of the story is that I came to help treat a few patients when the doctor was too busy and ended up staying to help with medical examinations because everyone liked my medicine for some reason.
I haven't been able to find Yuzu and Kaavi since I got here. I want to play too, but... if it's just me...
Yuzu
(Text Message) I've finished one round of the patrol of justice! {var:player_nickname}, what are you doing?
(Text Message) I'm with your teacher right now. Do you want to join us?
(Text Message) I think I better do some more patrolling... Take care, {var:player_nickname}, ahaha!
What is it, {var:player_nickname}? You can go if you need to do something.
That looks kind of fun...
Will you be okay? You just got better not long ago.
...You're such a thoughtful child. I can't remember when I last came to an amusement park with my students...
That would make me so happy, so of course I don't mind. {var:player_nickname}, this is a promise between the two of us, right?
This is my first time playing this ride, so I'm... a little nervous.
AHHH!
I wonder if Miss Leia will think I'm a little rude if I tell her honestly that I think her screaming sounds cute.
I want to play that again.
After that, we hop on the ride again and fly through the clear sky together with the help of the Pterodactyl wings.
Are you feeling dizzy? Here you go. I've already gotten the medicine ready for you.
...{var:player_nickname}, are you going to break your promise with me?

...I must be thinking too much then. When I brought Kaavi and Yuzu to the amusement park for the first time, we started off well, but then they suddenly said they would play other attractions and never came back to play with me.
I'm sorry for doubting you even though you specially offered to play with me.
I recall Yuzu's text message and suddenly vaguely understand why she told me to take care...
Have a good rest before we continue. I want to play the frisbee next. I wonder how fun that'll be.
I want to persuade Leia to play something more relaxing again, but I swallow my words when I see her slightly narrowed topaz-like eyes that are filled with eagerness.
...To be honest, I'm being optimistic when I say that her eyes are filled with eagerness. To put it bluntly... her eyes are telling me that I can't say no.
You'll... keep your promise, right?

I walk to the fairy tale town zone and look for a place to rest. Suddenly, a familiar-looking head of blue hair appears in my vision. It's Cynthia, and she is walking quickly with a balloon doll that looks out of place in her hands.
Girl A
I knew I was right! It really is Miss Cynthia! Can we take a photo together?
Girl B
We're your fans! What rides do you like, Miss Cynthia? Let's play on them together!!!
Cynthia
Thanks for supporting me, but I'm going to have to reject both of your requests. I'm here for work.
This is great! We can watch Cynthia while she is filming! Ahhhhhh! Where are we going now?!
Although there are only two fans here, they flank Cynthia on both sides and basically block her so that she is stuck in the middle of the road.
Let me say this again. I refuse to let you disrupt my filming schedule. Since you're my fans, I hope you can be aware that you need to observe public order.
You should go and have fun on the rides since you managed to get a ticket. My appearance won't change even if you stare at me for a long time, but the tourist rides will close at a certain time.
She's so cool and has such a personality...
The two girls leave happily even though they were rejected. The idol who has a vicious tongue and her fans who think that her vicious tongue is a virtue have a really touching relationship.
Yo, Cynthia.
Thanks for supporting me, but I can't take any photos with you... Oh, it's you.
Cynthia's relaxed expression suddenly becomes alert again.
I think someone is secretly taking photos of us.
Huh?

Cynthia looks into her make-up mirror and sees a little girl standing behind us. The little girl is hiding behind a princess statue and seems to be hesitating. Upon seeing this, both Cynthia and I are relieved.
You... really do have fans of all ages.
Cynthia rolls her eyes at me, then she walks towards the little girl while shaking the balloon in her hand.
You like this balloon, right?
Little Girl
Next time, you should speak out if you like something.
Cynthia kneels down and hands the balloon to the little girl. As if she's worried that the balloon will fly away, she gently ties the string of the balloon into a knot on the little girl's wrist.
Thanks!
The little girl runs off with the balloon.
How did you realize that she wanted the balloon?
I just thought about my first time at an amusement park. At that time, I didn't know my adoptive parents well enough to express my true thoughts to them.
Before we left, my mom asked me if I wanted the balloon the staff was holding. My precociousness made me overthink foolishly, so I told her I didn't want it.

In fact, I really wanted it. I should say that I felt envious... When I looked at the children who had balloons around me, I felt that I could be like them if I also had a balloon... I felt that I could be a child who was having fun with her parents.
Afterwards, my dad passed away and my mom got sick, so we never came to the amusement park together again. I never got the chance to tell them that I actually really wanted a balloon.
Just now, the look in her eyes reminded me of when I liked something but didn't dare to say it out loud.
Cynthia looks at the little girl with both regret and relief. Maybe she feels that the little girl has received the balloon she likes on behalf of her childhood self.
Since you can do something about it, why let yourself live with regrets?
Shall we ask the staff for some balloons too?
Forget it. Don't you think it's embarrassing for an adult to compete with children for balloons?
Haha, it's not embarrassing at all. I'll get one now.
Huh?! W-Wait up!
I quickly buy a balloon from a staff and hand it to Cynthia. After seeing that she isn't taking it, I tie it to the back of the bench next to her.
You... don't you have any sense of shame?!
Miss Cynthia, where are we?
A fairy tale village. So what?
Bingo! This is a child's paradise. The people who come here get to be children who never grow up.
Which means it's not necessary to feel ashamed about asking for a balloon.
What's more, both good deeds and evil deeds will be rewarded in kind. You helped someone else get a balloon, so I helped you get a balloon. Now the number of balloons in this world is balanced again.
This is sophistry...
Cynthia is about to complain about something else when a ringtone interrupts our conversation.
Okay, got it. I'll be right there.
Cynthia unties the balloon from the back of the bench. After noticing that I'm smiling at her, she rolls her eyes at me again.
This belongs to me now since you forced me to take it, so it's normal for me to take it with me. Stop making such a disgusting smile.
This is a normal smile, okay...
...{var:player_nickname}, do you have any plans for tonight?
It doesn't matter. Make time for me even if you already have plans. I'll treat you to dinner tonight.
You'll treat me to dinner? Why?
Geez... The line of people who want to have dinner with me is long enough to go from the Mahjong Soul Shrine to the pier of One Han City! You're actually asking me why...
I shouldn't accept a reward that I don't deserve. You should give me a reason at least.
Tsk... there's no reason! I just want to thank you on behalf of my childhood self.
Your childhood self?
Cynthia leaves before I can think about her words carefully.
...Oh well, I shouldn't mull over it. It's nice to have someone treat me to dinner, so I should just accept it happily, right?
After hearing Leia's words, I walk inside the treatment room from the consultation room and see Ayane Kisaragi sleeping soundly with a pillow in her arms on the bed.
Leia glances at the clock and nods thoughtfully before she adds another + symbol behind "Excessive sleepiness ++++" in her records.
I got a little carried away when I was playing and feel a little dizzy now... I felt better when I was chatting with you, but I'm starting to feel unwell again now...
Thank you.
Within just a few minutes of taking the medicine Leia gave me, my vision becomes clearer, and the dizziness that made me feel unwell disappears.
By the way, why did you come here to help out?
You don't go to an amusement park often. Don't you want to go and have some fun?
When Leia's eyes flicker across my body, I reach out my hand knowingly.
I'm all alone right now, so why don't we play together?
While Leia and I are walking and chatting, the sound of a text message interrupts us.
I look up to see Leia giving me a concerned look and quickly shake my head.
It's nothing. A friend just texted me about some everyday stuff.
Yuzu's words were a little strange... It's probably better to keep this from Leia for now.

While wandering around, Leia and I end up near a ride called Flying Pterodactyl, where lots of people are screaming. Leia stops and looks at the tourists who are hanging in the air, flying freely in the sky with their arms spread out.
If you're interested in it, why don't we get on this one?
Of course I'll be okay! If I get dizzy again, you're here to help me. I can always just take that medicine again.
When you're at an amusement park, the most important thing is to have fun and not worry too much.

Hearing Leia's words, and recalling the "professional dedication" of her two good students, I get the feeling that she's never played at an amusement park with her students, which makes me feel sad for her.
If you don't mind, let's have lots of fun together for the rest of the day.
Yes.
After lining up for half an hour, Leia and I finally managed to get on the Flying Pterodactyl, and she holds my hand tightly after the safety bar is secured.
Haha, nervously anticipating the moment a ride starts is also part of the fun of playing this kind of ride.

I can vaguely sense some moisture in the middle of Leia's warm palm. She strokes her chest and takes a deep breath before looking all around her. After that, she closes her eyes and purses her lips because she can't decide what she should focus her gaze on.

With a click, the Pterodactyl wings on our backs start rising into the air along the slope, and I can feel Leia's body shaking. Within two seconds of us reaching the highest point, I hear Leia screaming from beside me.
After we get back onto the ground, Leia stares blankly at the sky and expresses that she hasn't had enough yet.
Then let's play it again.
After this time, it feels like Leia has completely let loose and has a great time actively leading me in the adventure jungle. Her eyes shine brightly like the dazzling sun.
No... wait... I think I am getting dizzy again.
I'm naturally happy that Leia is having fun, but... she seems to like roller coaster rides too much and has to play each one several times before moving on.
Ugh... sorry, I need to take a break...
Thanks... umm, Leia, why don't we try some of the attractions in the other zones? There are lots of fun things there too.
No matter how quickly her medicine takes effect, after taking it to relieve my dizziness a few times, my mental state can no longer keep up with her.
Eh? That's not what I mean...
Leia, I...
...Yes.
It's important to keep your word, so I don't say anything else under Leia's "kind" gaze. Today's lesson has taught me that a promise is a heavy burden...
Just as I am about to approach her, two girls who are smiling with admiration reach her first.

It really is Cynthia! Damn it, why didn't the fansite administrator tell us that Cynthia would be going to the amusement park for filming? If I knew she would be here, I would have brought my camera to take photos of her!

...I knew I should have worn a mask when I left home today. It won't matter if it's a fan, but things will be troublesome for a while if an entertainment reporter makes it out to be a big scoop or something.
